data.name: See the sky
data.detailed_description:
See the sky — is a grim visual novel in the genre of psychological thriller and detective. You will be transported to the dying city of Freakfall, where the line between man and beast has long since been wiped out, with the most terrifying secrets not in a secret laboratory but in childhood memories.

WELCOME TO FREAKFALL!

FreakFall is a city on the northern seas of the New World that has been flooded with its own blood. The day called "Bloody Sky" has been a disaster for which someone must answer - but who?

Immerse yourself in a complicated and multilayered story where past and present are intertwined into a tight knot. You will become a witness and an accomplice to the fates of broken children - each one carrying darkness within themselves. Mass poisoning, political intrigues, a series of mysterious disappearances and brutal murders - these events not only bind the heroes together, but also make them question their own nature.

CAN YOU SEE THE LIGHT IN THE DARK?

As the protagonist, Tony Moro’s advisor is lost in a web of others' intrigues and memories. Together with the mysterious Narrator, he delves into the past, trying to understand what is really happening to the city and its residents. But the deeper he searches for the truth, the clearer his realization becomes: FreakFall is sick, and madness is already approaching him.

The usual reality is cracking at the seams. Can you solve the mystery of the city and save the innocent? And the main thing is, will Tony keep his senses or will darkness consume him and you?

GAME FEATURES

  • Visual novel with QTE elements. Make decisions in key scenes, react in dynamic episodes and gather evidence to dig into the truth.

  • Unreliable Narrator. The character leading you through the story is not just commenting on what’s going on. He has his motives, his theater and his own manuscript which he writes with the blood of heroes.

  • Nonlinear history. Explore the world with different characters in different time frames. Their stories are independent, but they come together in a tragic picture where the act of one ends in the fate of another.

  • Unique visual style. Comic style, a gloomy, uneasy noir and sunlight that here seems as dangerous as the darkness.

  • Two game modes.  

    "Interactive" - an original mode, designed by the author. Make decisions in key scenes, go through QTE and gather evidence to dig into the truth.

    "Story" - a light version without QTE scenes, for those who want to enjoy the story like a movie or book.

ATTENTION!

The game contains inappropriate language, scenes of psychological and physical violence, cruelty towards children, as well as episodes that can cause strong emotional experiences. Recommended for an adult audience ready for deep and dark storytelling. Be careful and take care of yourself!

data.short_description: Sometimes the only way to rewrite the past is to relive it. A visual novel in the genre of detective and psychological thriller, where you do not investigate crimes but the psyche and memories of the main characters.

content_descriptors.notes:
There is adult content in the game: violence (physical and psychological), blood, uncensored language, partial nudity (the scene does not have an erotic character), murder,  self-harm, cannibalism (is a specimen of the fictional race of people. )

All the elements listed are integral to the plot and serve to reveal characters and the gloomy atmosphere of the world, rather than being exploited for shock. The game is intended for an adult audience only, ready for a deep and emotionally charged narrative. Please take care of yourself.
